title: Deep Survey BFS Claims
description: Each line in claims.jsonl is one object matching this schema.

claim_id.description: Stable ID like C001, C012, C0123.

paper_id.description: Resolves to a row in paper_index.md.

section.description: Section, table, or figure reference within the paper. Examples: 'Abstract', '§4.3', 'Table 2', 'Figure 5'.

quote.description: Verbatim quote from the paper, OR an explicit table/figure reference description. Empty quote requires explicit table_ref or figure_ref.

table_ref.description: Specific table cell reference, e.g., 'Table 4, row LaBraM-base, column TUEG accuracy'.

figure_ref.description: Specific figure reference, e.g., 'Figure 5b, line REVE-large'.

superseded_by.description: If status='superseded', the claim_id that supersedes this one.
